location.provenance: This bill would, on and after July 1, 2023, prohibit a person, including a manufacturer, from selling or distributing in commerce in this state any new,  not  previously  owned,  juvenile  product,  that  contains regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), as defined.

reference.provenance: AB  652,  Friedman.  Product  safety:  juvenile  products:  chemicals: perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances.

status.provenance: An act to add Chapter 12.5 (commencing with Section 108945) to Part 3 of Division 104 of the Health and Safety Code, relating to product safety.

date.provenance: [Approved by Governor October 5, 2021. Filed with Secretary of State October 5, 2021.]

pfas_definition.provenance: (e)  'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'PFAS' means a  class  of  fluorinated  organic  chemicals  containing  at  least  one  fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: On and after July 1, 2023, a person, including, but not limited to, a manufacturer, shall not sell or distribute in commerce in this state any new, not previously owned, juvenile product that contains regulated PFAS chemicals.

who.provenance: a person, including, but not limited to, a manufacturer

action.provenance: shall not sell or distribute in commerce in this state

products.provenance: any new, not previously owned, juvenile product

intentionally_added.provenance: (1)  PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect in the product
